# Opening title card

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `studio`
- Slug: `studio/title-card`

## Summary

Darkroom recipe (basic). An opening title is short, centred and large, in a display or serif font, on screen 2 to 4 s with a fade in and out.

## Details

### When to use
The first seconds of a video.
### What a pro does and why
Over footage it needs either a dark background bar or a shadow to stay readable.
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Opening title",
  "reason": "You asked for an opening title: a title card at the start sets the topic",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "add_title", "template": "title", "lines": ["Summer in Lisbon"], "start": 0, "duration": 3, "style": {"fontFamily": "Playfair Display", "fontSizePx": 120, "fontWeight": 700, "fillColor": "#FFFFFF"}, "animateIn": "fade", "animateOut": "fade"}
  ]
}
```
### How to adjust
Unreadable: add style `backgroundColor` "#000000" with `backgroundOpacity` 0.4. More modern: `Bebas Neue`. Longer: duration 4.
